paper_comparison.summary: The paper requires the flavor-singlet condition at (6,1), q^7, within P=(xy+z^3)t+a*z*t^2 with the fixed reduced Higgs branch C^2/Z3. Independent QQ calculations give ordinary minimal singlet beta2=2: one universal Koszul class and one further class. Equation (3.6) prints one; this convention difference is unresolved and no universal class is silently subtracted. The previous charged diagnostic is outside the accepted paper verification and is withdrawn.

jump.detail: After reduction, P_a=(xy+z^3)t+a*z*t^2 has no essential coefficient: for nonzero a, t -> t/a identifies P_a with P_1/a.
